_README: Which edges are allowed to be called STRONG, and -- when the proven-edge
gate is on -- which are allowed to trade at all.
This ships EMPTY, and that is a measurement, not an oversight. A full
walk-forward pass over every strategy in this repository on 2026-09-02
validated nothing. The numbers are recorded in _refuted below so that the
next person to ask 'has anyone checked ADX?' can read the answer instead
An entry here is a claim with a scope. ProvenEdge.is_valid() re-derives
the verdict from the evidence fields every time the file is loaded, so
adding an edge_id without the supporting numbers does not unblock
anything -- the bars are min 30 out-of-sample trades, PF above 1.0,
positive cost-adjusted expectancy, and more than half the walk-forward
folds profitable. Those were fixed before the first result was seen.
symbols and timeframes are part of the claim. An edge validated on
EURUSD H1 is blocked on XAUUSD M15, because that distinction is exactly
what separated the one combination that looked profitable from the

edges._evidence: walk-forward 16 folds, H1, rr=3.0, sl=1.5 ATR, current cost model. net +634.2 on 78 OOS trades, pre-cost +663.5, cost/trade 0.38. The modelled gold spread of 0.25 was checked against the broker's live spread of 0.29, so this is not a cost-model artefact.
edges._scope_warning: XAUUSD only. The same strategy is below 1.0 on all six FX pairs measured the same day (0.73-0.96), so this is a claim about gold, not about the strategy.

edges._evidence: walk-forward 16 folds, H1, rr=3.0, sl=1.5 ATR, current cost model. net +85.4 on 41 OOS trades, pre-cost +236.7, cost/trade 3.69. The modelled EURUSD spread is wider than the broker currently quotes, so this figure is conservative.
edges._scope_warning: EURUSD only. Same strategy elsewhere: USDJPY 1.25 but 6/16 folds, AUDUSD 0.77, GBPUSD 0.72, XAUUSD 0.59, USDCHF 0.56, USDCAD 0.51.

_refuted._note: Measured 2026-09-03 across 7 symbols, H1, walk-forward 16 folds, rr=3.0, current cost model, unless stated otherwise.

TrendFollowing.why: below 1.0 on every FX pair measured: EURUSD 0.96, USDJPY 0.86, USDCHF 0.83, USDCAD 0.77, GBPUSD 0.76, AUDUSD 0.73. Validated on XAUUSD only -- see edges.

TrendPullback.why: built to fix TrendFollowing's state-vs-event entry; measured worse than the thing it replaced

EnsembleADXTrend.why: NOT MEASURED, not refuted. Zero trades on all 7 symbols because the harness did not register ADX, so the strategy read None on every bar. The harness was fixed after this run had started, so it still needs measuring.

DonchianBreakout.why: the best refused row of the sweep. GBPUSD 1.15 and XAUUSD 1.08 both failed the fold test at exactly 8/16; every other symbol between 0.70 and 0.97.

RSIMeanReversion.why: validated on EURUSD only. USDJPY reached PF 1.25 on 39 trades but only 6/16 folds; AUDUSD 0.77, GBPUSD 0.72, XAUUSD 0.59, USDCHF 0.56, USDCAD 0.51.

StrengthReversion.why: no symbol above 1.0: XAUUSD 0.92, USDCHF 0.88, GBPUSD 0.84, USDJPY 0.79, AUDUSD 0.78, USDCAD 0.74, EURUSD 0.69.

_selection_caveat: Both entries come from a single sweep of 7 symbols x 5 strategies on 2026-09-03. 28 cells carried trades and 2 cleared the bar. With 28 simultaneous hypotheses that yield is not distinguishable from chance, so these are hypotheses carried forward on a demo account, not established edges. The bar was fixed before any result was seen and was not moved afterwards: GBPUSD/DonchianBreakout at PF 1.15 was refused on exactly 8/16 folds, because half is not more than half.
